fusions.name: Splitting Bolt
fusions.desc: Spits a barbed bolt that deals 4 damage with a 20% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Cleft Loyalties
fusions.desc: Seizes up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 5 seconds. Each takes 10 damage and is stunned for 1 second, and the first to turn is slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blame Elsewhere
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a second strike hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage and slowing it by 30% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
